Kafka Streams is a higher-level stateful stream processing library and runtime; out of scope for the core client protocol library.
Kafka Connect is a connector plugin execution framework and cluster runtime; out of scope for the client messaging library.
A drop-in librdkafka C symbol ABI (rd_kafka_*) is out of scope; partitionline is designed as an idiomatic pure-Rust Kafka client.
LeaderAndIsr (api 4): internal broker-to-broker partition replica state propagation; out of scope for client libraries.
StopReplica (api 5): internal controller-to-broker partition replica deletion/shutdown; out of scope for client libraries.
UpdateMetadata (api 6): internal controller-to-broker cluster state broadcast; out of scope for client libraries.
ControlledShutdown (api 7): broker-to-controller graceful shutdown coordination; out of scope for client libraries.
AlterPartition (api 56): broker partition leader-to-controller ISR state updates; out of scope for client libraries.
Envelope (api 58): internal request forwarding wrapper between brokers and controller; out of scope for client libraries.
FetchSnapshot (api 59): KRaft controller quorum state-machine snapshot replication; out of scope for client libraries.
BrokerRegistration (api 62): KRaft broker lifecycle bootstrap registration; out of scope for client libraries.
BrokerHeartbeat (api 63): KRaft broker periodic liveness heartbeat to controller; out of scope for client libraries.
ControllerRegistration (api 70): KRaft controller election and registration; out of scope for client libraries.
UpdateRaftVoter (api 82): KRaft internal voter metadata update; out of scope for client libraries.

ShareGroupState internal persistence RPCs (apis 83-87: InitializeShareGroupState, ReadShareGroupState, WriteShareGroupState, DeleteShareGroupState, ReadShareGroupStateSummary) are broker-to-persister partition state store RPCs, not client-facing.
